acceptanceCriteria: internal/appmap/gitread.go and internal/appflows/repositories.go stop carrying the repository-root locator literal, or a project-owned locator-exemption declaration covers them, without hiding a real unbounded reader
The V1-0081 unresolved count is re-measured and drops by those 62 packages
A one-package change's selection is re-measured and retained
body: Measured by the affected-selection lane (claude/batch-affected-selection) at origin/main 5cf75daf0 on 2026-10-21. After V1-0634, 104 of 357 packages are still unresolved for the V1-0081 floor. 62 of them inherit that status only because a dependency's product code contains the literal `--show-toplevel`. Changing internal/appflows/repositories.go to `--show-prefix` has no effect on its own, because internal/appmap/gitread.go then becomes the cause for the same 62 packages. A one-package change still selects 143-146 packages. Blocks the rest of V1-0081.
title: affected: 62 packages stay unresolved only because appmap/appflows product code contains the literal `--show-toplevel`
